comparison.objective: Clear a towel from a rice-cooker steam vent before pressing COOK; candidate adjusts and locks gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize and remove a safety obstruction, place it securely, and actuate a plunger versus coordinated tool seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Vent clear before activation, towel supported, button released, grippers withdrawn, and final state held one second; unsafe activation permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Safe prerequisite handling and button activation do not test mechanical calibration, locknut retention, or repeated actuation.
